newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures except spot Sept ease.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures except spot Sept ease.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures, except for the spot September contract, ended weaker on Tuesday, but recovered from early lows, buoyed by short-covering later in the day, traders said. Activity was lacklustre.
The spot September contract ended 1.8 yen per kg firmer at 133.1 yen. Other contracts ranged from 0.1 yen to 0.7 yen lower with benchmark February finishing 0.2 yen weaker at 140.4 yen.

Trade was mainly spurred by technical factors ahead of the spot expiry on Sept 24. "The spot September contract gained from early lows, due to emerging views that trade houses will be willing to take deliveries at the expiry," one trader said.
